data.case_title: Bußgeldbescheid (fine notice) for speeding – €182.00, Az. VOW 4.1-26/308812
data.title: Fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for speeding, €182.00 total
data.summary: The Zentrale Bußgeldbehörde Beispielsaarland issued a fine notice for speeding 27 km/h over the 70 km/h limit outside built-up areas on 29 September 2026 near Beispielwadern. The total amount due is €182.00 (fine, fee and delivery costs), and the violation is recorded with 1 point in the driving register (Fahreignungsregister).
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for a speeding offence. You may decide whether to accept it or file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, or in person at the Bußgeldbehörde — the app shows until when you can still do this. If you don't object by the deadline shown, the notice becomes legally final (rechtskräftig) and can be enforced. Only pay the €182.00 once it has become final, then within two weeks, to the account shown. The offence will also be recorded with 1 point. If you're unsure whether to object, consider getting advice from a traffic lawyer (Verkehrsrechtsanwalt) before the deadline.
